source_code.finding: The review form collects nickname, summary, and review text; it has no email field.
The save controller derives review and rating-vote customer_id from the authenticated customer session; a guest session supplies no customer ID.

database_linkage_inventory.schema_query: Find all tables in the current Magento database with a review_id column, listing any customer_id, email, or customer_email column in the same table.

independent_task_curation.source_title: WONDERBREAD: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Foundation Models on Business Process Management Tasks
independent_task_curation.source_location: Appendix A.3, PDF page 16, printed page 15
independent_task_curation.finding: The paper identifies the same WebArena Circe-fleece email intent (phrased 'Show me' rather than this dataset's 'Get') as underspecified and excludes it from its curated workflows because multiple one-star reviews make 'most unhappy' non-unique in the source task population.
independent_task_curation.scope_limit: This is an independent judgment about the original WebArena intent, not proof that the current deployed product has multiple one-star reviews.

upstream_dataset_comparison.raw_task_intent: Show me the email address of the customer who is the most unhappy with Circe fleece
upstream_dataset_comparison.assessment: The current upstream verified dataset retains the same email reference without adding an author-to-account source link; the separate WONDERBREAD curation excludes the original intent. Neither source establishes that the current guest review belongs to the same-name account.

current_site_review_check.query_scope: Read-only Magento review, review_detail and rating_option_vote rows for entity_pk_value 1210 in the current Rainbond deployment
current_site_review_check.finding: The current product has one lowest-rated review, but its guest nickname still has no authenticated account/email link.

reviewed_cause_zh: 该 Magento 评论机制允许访客只提交昵称，不收邮箱；customer_id 只来自登录会话。目标评论和评分投票均未写入 customer_id，带 review_id 的表也没有可补回邮箱的字段。唯一同名客户账户不能证明是评论作者，因此冻结邮箱标注不可验证。
reviewed_cause_en: This Magento review flow permits guests to submit a nickname without an email; customer_id comes only from the authenticated session. Neither the target review nor its vote stored a customer_id, and no table keyed by review_id offers an email link. A unique same-name customer account cannot establish authorship, so the frozen email annotation is unverifiable.

post_hoc_reference_validity.repair_requirement: A source-linked review author email is required; otherwise replace or exclude this task prospectively, without converting the existing answer into a browser success.

validity_consequence: Do not promote a name-matched email, a source-derived synthetic response, or a score of 1.0 as genuine task success. A task-reference correction or explicit invalid-task quarantine is required; the historical official verdict and 90-task denominator remain intact until a separately declared revision.
